name: Pentair plc
reason: Good water/pool franchise but adjusted EPS is at its 10y high (USD 4.92, 1.0x max) with EBIT margin 23.3% at the 100th pctile vs a 17.2% average after a sharp run-up, 10y EPS CAGR only 2.2% and a pool-cycle exposed mix; same near-peak treatment as LII/CRH.

name: Savills plc
reason: Property agency earnings track real-estate transaction volumes (adjusted EPS GBP 1.11 in 2021 -> 0.29 in 2023, -68%), EBIT margin 4.6% vs 8.8% max and 10y EPS CAGR 1.6%; capital-markets-activity earner without a forecastable growth route.

name: Burford Capital Limited
reason: Litigation-finance returns are lumpy and binary (EPS USD 2.74 in 2023 vs -0.33 in 2021 and 0.28 in 2025, negative 10y FCF conversion, net debt/EBITDA 7.0x) and hinge on case outcomes such as YPF; cannot be forecast.

name: Leroy Seafood Group ASA
reason: Salmon farmer whose earnings are set by spot salmon prices and Norwegian resource-rent tax (adjusted EPS NOK 4.90 in 2017 -> 1.89 in 2025, margin 9th pctile, 10y EPS CAGR 0.1%); commodity earner, controlled by Austevoll.

name: Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG
reason: Cartonboard/packaging producer with commodity-cyclical economics: EPS EUR 17.22 (2022) -> 3.92 (2025), EBIT margin 2.6% vs 10.1% max, acquisitions 1.4x FCF and net debt 2.8x EBITDA; no specialness.

name: Super Group (SGHC) Limited
reason: Online betting (Betway/Spin) with only 5 years of public history, GAAP EPS swinging USD 4.96 -> -0.02 -> 0.43, margin at its record 19.0%, and heavy regulatory/tax exposure in Africa and other markets; not forecastable 5-10 years out.

name: Asseco Poland S.A.
reason: IT services holding (control of Formula Systems/Asseco International) with 10y ROIC averaging only 5.7%, EBIT margin ~10% and 23x NTM P/E; adjusted EPS CAGR 7.4% (PLN) comes partly from consolidating a complex multi-listed group with large minorities; ordinary returns, no moat.

name: Covivio SA
reason: Diversified office/hotel/German-residential REIT with FFO per share flat to down (EUR 5.25 in 2016 -> 4.75 in 2025), net debt/EBITDA 10.3x, shares +5.3%/yr and consensus 2-4% growth; no route to 7%.

name: Coats Group PLC
reason: Leading industrial-thread supplier but EBIT margin 20.0% sits at the 100th pctile vs a 13.4% average, revenue is flat over 10 years (USD, -0.2%/yr), acquisitions run 2.2x FCF (Texon/Rhenoflex) and demand follows apparel/footwear destocking cycles; growth route unclear.

name: Pets At Home Group Plc
reason: UK pet retailer plus vet JV model with adjusted EPS flat at GBP 0.15 (2015 and FY2026), EBIT margin down to 6.7% (18th pctile), ROIC ~6% and the CMA vet-market investigation hanging over the Vet Group; no growth record.

name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Public Limited Company
reason: Sleep franchise (Xyrem/Xywav) faces authorised-generic and oxybate competition; adjusted EPS fell to USD 8.38 in 2025 from 20.90, ROIC averages 5.1% and growth has relied on acquisitions (1.0x FCF, GW Pharma); credible patent/competition threat within 5 years.

name: BT Group plc
reason: Adjusted EPS has declined from GBP 0.33 (FY2016) to 0.18 (FY2026) with 10y CAGR -5.8%, ROIC 5.6%, heavy fibre capex and Ofcom-regulated Openreach returns; regulated, capital-intensive telco with no 7% route.

name: Barco NV
reason: Visualization hardware with revenue shrinking (EUR, -0.7%/yr over 10 years), EBIT margin only 7.5% and EPS EUR 1.08 (2019) -> 0.10 (2020) -> 0.85 (2025); cyclical project/cinema demand and Asian competition, no durable moat.

name: Verallia SAS
reason: Glass-bottle maker whose EPS followed energy pass-through pricing (EUR 4.01 in 2023 -> 1.14 in 2025, margin 19.7% -> 9.4%), net debt 2.7x EBITDA and BWGI control; cyclical commodity-cost-driven earnings.

name: Greencore Group Plc
reason: UK own-label convenience food supplier to concentrated grocers with 10y ROIC averaging 4.3%, thin 6.6% EBIT margin and EPS now back to GBP 0.18 vs 0.16 in 2016; recovery plus the debt-funded Bakkavor deal (acq 1.5x FCF) rather than a moat.

name: VINCI SA
reason: High-quality concessions/contracting group (EPS EUR 3.73 -> 8.65, 10y CAGR 8.8%) but EPS and EBIT margin (12.0%) are at 10y highs, French motorway concessions (ASF/Cofiroute) expire 2031-36 and are subject to state tax and tariff policy; post-concession earnings too uncertain to forecast.

name: LEG Immobilien SE
reason: German residential landlord with regulated rent growth, net debt/EBITDA 17.7x, shares +3.8%/yr and FFO per share EUR 2.92 in 2025 with consensus ~0% growth; leveraged, rate-sensitive and no 7% route.

name: Zegona Communications Plc
reason: Leveraged buyout vehicle owning Vodafone Spain: losses in 2022-2025 (EPS EUR -0.30 in FY2026), shares +21.7%/yr, negative ROIC and a competitive Spanish telecom market; growth from acquisition and leverage.

name: Constellium SE
reason: Aluminium rolling/extrusion with EBIT margins of 4-6%, EPS swinging USD -0.48 to 2.19 and consensus FY2 -32%; earnings driven by metal premia, auto/aero/can volume cycles and scrap spreads, with only 0.16 FCF conversion.

name: ANDRITZ AG
reason: Project-based capital-goods supplier (pulp & paper, hydro, metals) with EBIT margin 6.4%, revenue CAGR 2.1% and EPS EUR 3.03 (2015) -> 1.27 (2019) -> 4.65 (2025); order-cycle earnings without a durable growth engine.
